svg.title: Account Project and RBAC data relationships
svg.desc: The Organization owns Security Principals, accounts, Projects, Role Definitions and Scopes. Actor and Business Group are mutually exclusive principal kinds. Project and Group membership are separate from Role Assignments. Each Role Assignment binds exactly one Security Principal, one immutable Role Definition version and one Scope. A decision may be supported by many applicable assignments, recorded through contribution rows. Scope parent-child rows make the hierarchy explicit without a recursive self-loop.
